name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi rozhodně stojí za návštěvu. Akvária mám projitá po celém světě – v Evropě, Americe i Asii – a tohle bez váhání řadím mezi ta úplně nejlepší.
Akvárium je rozděleno do deseti tematických zón, které na sebe plynule navazují. Vše je perfektně čisté, moderní, vizuálně velmi dobře řešené a zároveň přehledné i pro rodiny s dětmi. Je vidět, že jde o nové a velmi dobře udržované místo.
Mezi největší taháky patří kapustňák, arapajma gigas a hlavně velký podvodní tunel, kde se nad vámi pohybují žraloci, včetně kladivounů. Celé to působí velmi přirozeně, expozice nejsou přeplácané a zvířata jsou dobře viditelná. Zážitek je silný jak pro děti, tak pro dospělé.
Menší, ale praktická kritická poznámka:
během celé prohlídkové trasy je minimum toalet. Jedna větší možnost je až před hlavním tunelem. Pokud jdete s dětmi, určitě doporučuji využít toalety hned na začátku, jinak vás čeká nepříjemné vracení se zpět po trase.
Vstupné je podle mého názoru přiměřené kvalitě i délce návštěvy. Lístky jsme kupovali přímo na místě a nebyl s tím žádný problém. Akvárium je plně klimatizované, což je v Abu Dhabi velké plus, zejména v teplejších měsících.
Doprava je velmi jednoduchá – Uber je v Abu Dhabi spolehlivý, dostupný a cenově rozumný, z centra města naprosto bez problému.
Velkou výhodou je i samotná lokalita. V bezprostředním okolí je krásná promenáda plná restaurací a kaváren a hned na stejné ulici se nachází velké zábavní centrum se spoustou atrakcí pro děti i dospělé. Pokud tedy plánujete program mimo samotné centrum Abu Dhabi, dá se zde bez problému strávit celý den – my jsme to tak měli, včetně oběda, procházky po promenádě a posezení v kavárnách.
Shrnuto:
moderní, špičkově udělané akvárium světové úrovně, které funguje nejen jako samostatná atrakce, ale i jako ideální základna pro celodenní program s rodinou. Jednoznačně doporučuji.

name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
The National Aquarium is the largest aquarium in the Middle East, located in the Al Qana development in Abu Dhabi. It is home to over 46,000 animals from more than 300 unique species across 10 themed zones, ranging from the UAE’s marine treasures to the frozen Arctic and the Red Sea Wreck.

Notable features include the region's longest underwater tunnel and a focus on marine conservation and education. Visitors can enjoy interactive experiences like glass-bottom boat tours, a glass bridge walk, and animal encounters with sharks, rays, and puffins. It stands as a major family attraction dedicated to exploring and preserving the marine environment.

name: The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi
review_text:
Our visit to The National Aquarium Abu Dhabi was truly exceptional. The entire experience was educational, engaging, and perfectly designed for families. The exhibits are beautifully arranged, the environment is clean and well-organized, and the variety of marine life is simply impressive. It’s a place where children learn while having fun, and adults enjoy every moment just as much.

I would also like to extend special thanks and appreciation to Ms. Hanan, one of the staff members who made our visit unforgettable. She took the time to give my children a detailed explanation about how animals are examined, cared for, rehabilitated, and eventually released back into Abu Dhabi’s natural environment. Her passion, knowledge, and kindness truly stood out. She made the experience more meaningful and inspired my children to appreciate wildlife conservation.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Abu Dhabi—an amazing place with amazing people behind it.

review_text:
تجربة مذهلة في ناشونال أكواريوم أبوظبي!
المكان مُصمّم بشكل احترافي يأخذ الزائر في رحلة بحرية فريدة عبر عالم الكائنات المائية. التنوع الكبير في الأحياء البحرية ملفت جدًا، من الأسماك الاستوائية إلى الحيوانات النادرة، وكل منطقة مصممة بعناية لتجعل التجربة غنية وممتعة.

الممرات واسعة ومنظمة، والعروض التعليمية داخل الأكواريوم تضيف قيمة كبيرة للزيارة، خاصة الشرح حول الحياة البحرية وجهود المحافظة على البيئة. طريقة عرض الكائنات رائعة، والزجاجات الضخمة تمنحك رؤية واضحة وقريبة تشعرك وكأنك داخل المحيط.

الخدمة ممتازة والموظفون لطفاء ويقدمون معلومات مفيدة للزوار، خاصة للأطفال، مما يجعل التجربة تعليمية وترفيهية في الوقت نفسه. مستوى النظافة والتنظيم عالي جدًا، والأسعار مناسبة مقارنة بحجم المعرض وتجربة الزائر.

منطقة الأنشطة الخارجية مثل ركوب القوارب الزجاجية أو تجربة المشي فوق الجسر المعلق تضيف بعدًا إضافيًا للتجربة وتستحق التجربة.

بشكل عام، يعتبر ناشونال أكواريوم من أفضل الوجهات العائلية في أبوظبي لمن يرغب في قضاء وقت ممتع ومليء بالإبهار والمعرفة. أنصح بزيارته بقوة

호텔 까페의 금카푸치노와 금이 올라간 아이스크림을 먹기 위해 방문
아부다비 일일투어에 포함되어 방문하게 되었는데,
호텔의 거대한 외관과 입구에서 보이는 아부다비 시내의 멋진 전경에 감탄하였음
일반고객의 숙박이 가능한 윙이 있고, 본건물은 특별한 투숙객을 위한 고가의 방들이라고 설명들음

로비입구에 아부다비 역대 왕들의 사진이 걸려있었고,
거대한 중앙로비에는 시즌인 만큼 크리스마스 트리가 있었음
로비 안쪽에 베이커리와 까페가 있었는데
호텔 모양의 홀케익과 미니케익 그리고 다양한 디저트를 판매하고 있었고 이 곳의 까페에서 금커피(금카푸치노)를 체험함

두바이 몰에서도 금커피를 마셨지만, 개인적으로 두바이 여행에서의 커피 맛은 그리 성공적이진 않았음
금가루와 초콜렛 아트로 장식된 커피 한잔은 여행의 기념사진으로는 남겨볼만함
초콜렛 젤라또 아이스크림 맛은 훌륭했고, 콘의 와플맛은 별로였음

가격은 예상한대로 매우 높음

name: Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental
review_text:
Episodes Coffee Shop
Very poor service and extremely unwelcoming attitude.
I visited Episodes with my 15 guests. While I understand a coffee shop may require orders, the way this was handled was unprofessional and rude. The staff made it mandatory for every single guest to order, without any polite explanation or flexibility.
The service itself was chaotic and unpleasant:
Orders for 15 people were taken in a disorganized manner
Drinks were called out loudly like a supermarket queue
No smiles, no courtesy, no basic customer service
One staff member behaved as if she was doing us a favor by serving us
To make matters worse, although we arrived before last orders (10:30 PM) and stayed for just 45 minutes the staff complained about us coming “at this time 9:45pm” and openly stated that serving a group of 15 was too much for them.
Guests should never be made to feel unwelcome or like a burden. This experience was stressful, uncomfortable, and far from acceptable. In Sand & Koal restaurant I have a similar bad experience for my wedding anniversary but I thought to give them a second chance truly is not worth it.
owner_answer:
Dear Alaa,

Thank you for sharing your feedback and my profound apologies for the impression reflected and inconvenience caused.

I have personally reviewed your comments with our Director of F&B for immediate address to improve our service level. It is not our normal standard and rest assured that every effort is being made to ensure that we meet or exceed our guests' expectations.

We greatly appreciate your kind patronage and look forward to welcoming you back as we strive to serve you better in the future.

Sincerely,
Charles Aird
Hotel Manager

query: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Abu Dhabi
name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text:
Visitare la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed ad Abu Dhabi è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e profonde del mio viaggio negli Emirati Arabi Uniti. Non è solo una tappa panoramica, ma una delle attrazioni culturali e spirituali più impressionanti del mondo moderno. Appena ci si avvicina, la sua facciata in marmo bianco immacolato con oltre 80 cupole e minareti imponenti è mozzafiato, un vero simbolo di Abu Dhabi che combina architettura islamica tradizionale e maestosità contemporanea. All’interno, la sala di preghiera principale lascia senza parole: il gigantesco tappeto fatto a mano (il più grande del mondo), i lampadari decorati con cristalli e i dettagli in foglia d’oro creano un’atmosfera di bellezza e pace difficili da descrivere. La luce sul marmo e le piscine riflettenti rendono la moschea ancora più spettacolare al tramonto o alla sera, quando le ombre giocano sui mosaici e i colori cambiano gradualmente.
Visitare questo luogo ti fa pensare sia all’arte e all’architettura, sia alla cultura e alla spiritualità che ispira milioni di persone ogni giorno. È importante ricordare di seguire il dress code rispettoso richiesto per l’accesso (spalle e gambe coperte, e per le donne anche testa coperta), una regola che contribuisce al senso di rispetto all’interno di un luogo di culto attivo. Per me la Gran Moschea dello Sceicco Zayed è una delle meraviglie architettoniche più belle che abbia visto, un luogo dove la grandiosità incontra la serenità. Che tu sia religioso o meno, la visita è emozionante, istruttiva e visivamente straordinaria, una tappa assolutamente da non perdere ad Abu Dhabi. Entra con calma al mattino presto o al tramonto per un’esperienza più tranquilla e fotografie spettacolari!

review_text:
Allereerst: waarom slechts 3 sterren, terwijl het een fantastisch mooi gebouw is?

Ongeveer 10 jaar geleden waren we ook in Abu Dhabi en zijn met een taxi naar de moskee gereden. Mijn vrouw kon ter plekke een chador lenen, tas controleren, door een poortje en je stond op het plein voor de moskee.

Vanwege covid worden er geen chadors meer uitgeleend (begrijpelijk). Dus zijn er winkeltjes waar je voor een bescheiden bedrag bedekkende kleding kunt kopen. So far so good.

Alleen toen we drie weken geleden met een tour vanuit Dubai aankwamen bleek dat er een compleet ondergronds winkelcentrum is gebouwd, inclusief foodcourt met Burgerking...

Onbegrijpelijk dat men zo'n prachtig religieus gebouw op deze manier heeft omgebouwd tot een soort Efteling.

Heel jammer!

review_text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi’nin ve hatta dünyanın en etkileyici yapılarından biri. Mimarisindeki zarafet, bembeyaz mermerlerin ihtişamı ve detaylardaki ince işçilik insanı ilk anda büyülüyor. İçeri adım attığınız anda huzur, saygı ve hayranlık duygusu aynı anda hissediliyor. Gerek gündüz gerek akşam ışıklandırmasıyla bambaşka bir atmosfere bürünen bu muazzam yapı, hem manevi hem görsel olarak unutulmaz bir deneyim sunuyor.

Küçük ama önemli bir not: girişte kıyafet kurallarına özellikle dikkat ediliyor. Transparan ve uygun olmayan kıyafetlerle içeri alınmıyor. Hatta bizden oldukça garip bir şekilde çorap giymemizi bile istemişlerdi 😄 Bu detayı bilerek gitmekte fayda var. Abu Dhabi’ye yolu düşen herkesin mutlaka görmesi gereken, gerçekten ikonik bir eser. 🤍✨

name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text:
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is absolutely breathtaking and one of the most unforgettable places i have ever visited — truly a must visit.

the scale of this mosque is incredible. it covers a huge area of about 22 400 square meters (about the size of five football fields) and can welcome tens of thousands of worshippers, with its elegant architecture and peaceful atmosphere inspiring awe the moment you arrive.  ￼

everywhere you look, the details are insane. the walls and columns are inlaid with marble and semi‑precious stones such as lapis lazuli, amethyst, mother‑of‑pearl and red agate — every piece of craftsmanship feels like art.  ￼

inside, the centerpiece is the world’s largest hand‑knotted carpet, covering over 5 600 square meters and weighing around 35 tons — a masterpiece woven by more than a thousand artisans with billions of knots of wool and cotton.  ￼

the chandeliers are equally stunning, studded with millions of crystals, and reflect light in the most beautiful way. the patterns on the floors and ceilings, the gold accents, the geometry — it all comes together in such a harmonious and majestic design that you can’t help but say wow, just wow.  ￼

overall, this mosque is not just a building, it’s a work of art and devotion, with every detail crafted to perfection. if you find yourself in abu dhabi, you absolutely have to see it — it will leave you speechless.

query: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Abu Dhabi
name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
review_text: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is one of those places that leaves a strong impression without trying too hard. The architecture is beautiful, especially for a relatively modern structure, with an incredible level of detail throughout. The mosque is immaculately maintained, and the open, expansive spaces make the visit feel calm and unhurried. Everything is very well organised, with a smooth and well managed flow from entry to exit. The only slightly tiring part is the amount of walking involved, which can be a bit much if you are visiting with toddlers or elderly family members. However, buggies are available and help make the experience much easier. Overall, it is a thoughtfully managed and memorable place to visit in Abu Dhabi.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
La visita a Qasr Al Watan, il Palazzo Presidenziale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti ad Abu Dhabi, è stata una delle esperienze più suggestive e memorabili del mio viaggio. Questo luogo non è una semplice attrazione turistica, ma un monumento culturale e simbolico che racconta la storia, l’arte, la conoscenza e la visione del Paese. Appena arrivi ti resta impressa la facciata maestosa in granito bianco e pietra, con dettagli lavorati e decorazioni che esprimono lusso e identità araba. La struttura è enorme e ogni sala, corridoio o galleria ha un impatto visivo impressionante, soprattutto la Great Hall con il suo enorme lampadario, che ti lascia davvero senza parole. Entrare qui significa fare un viaggio nella storia e nei valori degli Emirati. Ci sono esposizioni che illustrano l’evoluzione politica e sociale del Paese, oggetti diplomatici, e una biblioteca ricca di testi rari che riflette la profonda attenzione alla conoscenza e alla cultura.
Una delle parti più belle della visita è lo spettacolo di luci e suoni “Palace in Motion” che si tiene in serata: la facciata del palazzo si trasforma in un enorme schermo che racconta, con proiezioni e musica, la storia e le aspirazioni degli Emirati. È un momento suggestivo e molto scenografico. Mi raccomando, pantaloni lunghi o gonne sotto il ginocchio, perché è un luogo istituzionale. Prenota il biglietto in anticipo per evitare code, soprattutto nei periodi di alta stagione. Dedica almeno 1–2 ore se vuoi esplorare bene le sale e vivere anche lo spettacolo serale. Per me Qasr Al Watan non è solo un palazzo, ma un’esperienza culturale e visiva che racconta l’anima degli Emirati, ricca di architettura spettacolare, storia e tradizione. È un must se visiti Abu Dhabi, e la sua maestosità ti rimane impressa molto dopo che te ne sei andato.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Der Qasr Al-Watan ist ein absoluter Traumpalast, den man bei einem Besuch in Abu Dhabi unbedingt besichtigen sollte.

Eintritt: die Eintrittskarten können ausschließlich online gekauft werden, und an der Kasse muss dann der QR-Code vorgezeigt werden.

Sicherheitskontrolle: obwohl der Palast von sehr vielen Menschen besucht wurde, ging die Sicherheitskontrolle erstaunlicherweise schnell voran, und nach der Sicherheitskontrolle werden alle Besucher mit Bussen zum Haupteingang gefahren.

Benötigte Besuchszeit: planen Sie für die Besichtigung des Qasr Al-Watan, mindestens 1 1/2 - 2 Stunden ein, da es abgesehen von dem Palast selbst, auch interessante Ausstellungsräume zu besichtigen gibt, in denen dem Besucher zum Beispiel Geschenke zu repräsentiert werden, die dem Herrscher von Abu Dhabi wären Staatsbesuchen gemacht wurden. Eine kleine Ausstellung thematisiert auch die Geschichte der Raumfahrt in den vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten, und auch die Besichtigung des Bankett, sowie einer Ausstellung über Kalligraphie, sind sehr sehenswert im Qasr Al-Watan.

Tipp: Abends um 19:15 Uhr gibt es vor dem Palast eine Lichtershow, die sie unbedingt sehen sollten!

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Qasr Al Watan — это настоящий дворец-шедевр в Абу-Даби, который невозможно забыть. Открытый для публики в 2019 году  и поражает как масштабами, так и утончённой красотой.

С первых минут понимаешь: здесь каждая деталь произведение искусства. Главный зал с куполом диаметром 37 метров и высотой 60 метров парит над тобой, как небесный свод. Стены украшены тончайшими орнаментами в бело-золотой гамме, выполненными вручную, а мрамор, привезённый из лучших уголков мира, сияет в солнечном свете.

Залы дворца - это отдельные миры. Hall of Knowledge хранит редкие книги и манускрипты, Banquet Hall впечатляет столами длиной 120 метров, а Gift Hall демонстрирует изысканные подарки мировых лидеров. Огромные люстры, каждая весом несколько тонн, свисают как каскады звёзд.

Qasr Al Watan - это не просто туристическая достопримечательность, а символ культуры и роскоши ОАЭ. Если вы хотите увидеть восточный люкс в его высшем проявлении, прикоснуться к величию архитектуры и почувствовать себя частью чего-то грандиозного -это место обязательно для посещения

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text: An enormous presidential palace, absolutely stuffed with lots of swishiness!  The scale and opulence of this palace is unbelievable, especially as it is only used for meetings and no one lives there!  You need to catch the free shuttle bus to get to the palace, and also have your bags scanned/checked.  No big deal all this is done very efficiently and quickly, bus ride is only a few minutes.  Once inside you will see how huge and cavernous the palace is,  there are a few restricted areas and some rooms you can only look through the door.  Speaking of doors, the main doors are massive and apparently weigh something like 50 tons!  Some rooms have small exhibitions of artifacts, costumes etc.  The library is huge as you would expect, although the shelves are not completely full!  There are some pleasant garden areas and a water fountain, accessible to tourists too.  1-2 hours should be enough time for your visit.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
(2025.11.) 입장권을 현장에서 구매하면 75디르함으로 인터넷 구매보다 비쌉니다. 저는 마이**트립으로 구매했는데 1만 7천원 정도였습니다. 사전 구매하면 QR코드가 있는 pdf 파일을 받게 되는데 입장 시 방문객센터 오른쪽의 Ticket Counter가 아닌 왼쪽 문으로 바로 들어가면 됩니다.
아부다비 왕가의 장엄함을 그대로 보여 주는 건물입니다. 아랍의 전통미를 반영한 하얀색과 금색의 조화가 매우 뛰어납니다. 셰이크 자이드 그랜드 모스크와 유사한 분위기이면서도 국가 의전에 쓰이는 건물다운 면모도 보입니다.
건물 자체도 뛰어나지만 국가 정상 간에 주고 받은 선물이라든지 아랍 문자에 관한 전시 등 다른 볼거리도 많습니다. 우리나라에서 선물한 도자기, 자개, 단도 등이 다른 나라의 선물들과 함께 전시되어 있어 흥미로웠습니다.

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Visiting Qasr Al Watan was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Everything was organized beautifully, beginning with the ease of online booking—the process was smooth, quick, and straightforward, which made planning the visit completely hassle-free.

Upon arrival, the experience only got better. The shuttle bus that takes you to the palace entrance was comfortable and well-managed, setting the tone for the high level of hospitality you feel throughout the visit.

Stepping inside the palace is like entering another world. The architecture, details, and craftsmanship are absolutely breathtaking. Every hall tells a story, and every corner reflects the rich heritage and vision of the UAE.

Walking through the different halls was truly mesmerizing—each space more impressive than the one before. But the highlight of the visit for me was the Presidential Gifts Hall. Seeing the collection of gifts presented to the UAE from leaders around the world was fascinating. Every piece carries deep meaning and represents a moment of diplomacy, friendship, and respect between nations.

Overall, Qasr Al Watan offers a perfect combination of culture, history, and beauty. If you're visiting Abu Dhabi or even living in the UAE, this is a must-see landmark. The entire experience was seamless, enriching, and simply amazing.
Highly recommended!

name: Qasr Al Watan
review_text:
Het presidentieel paleis

Qasr Al Watan is zonder twijfel één van de meest indrukwekkende bezienswaardigheden van Abu Dhabi. Ga zeker met zonsondergang: vooral buiten is het fenomenaal mooi. In het warme licht van de ondergaande zon voelt het alsof je in een scène uit Aladdin terechtkomt.

Binnen is het “groot, groter, grootst”. De zalen zijn stijlvol ingericht in wit, geel en lichtblauw, zo groots en verfijnd dat je het amper kunt bevatten.

Blijf vooral tot na zonsondergang om de Palace in Motion lichtshow mee te pikken. Die is absoluut de moeite waard. Check wel vooraf de tijden online, want die veranderen per maand. Onze originele reservatie werd enkele dagen op voorhand geannuleerd door een ceremonieel bezoek, maar we konden gelukkig nog verplaatsen.

Een majestueuze ervaring die je niet snel vergeet.

name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text: Snow Abu Dhabi is a fun and unique indoor snow park, especially great for families and first-time visitors. The snow setting, play areas, and rides create an enjoyable winter experience in the middle of the city. However, it’s important to check ride availability before going, as some attractions — especially the zip line — may be closed at times due to maintenance. The number of rides is limited, so it’s best planned as a 2–3 hour visit rather than a full-day trip. Overall, it’s a nice, well-maintained attraction for short, fun-filled snow time.

Unforgettable Experience at Snow Abu Dhabi

Our visit to Snow Abu Dhabi was truly amazing and beyond our expectations. The entire place is magical, well-organized, and perfect for all ages. From the moment we entered, the atmosphere already felt special.

The entire crew deserves high praise for being so friendly, helpful, and professional. name: Snow Abu dhabi
review_text:
مرحبا بالجميع
تجربة ممتعة وفريدة في سنو أبوظبي!
المكان مصمّم بطريقة رائعة تجعلك تعيش أجواء الثلج الحقيقية وسط أبوظبي، ويُعد واحدًا من أفضل الوجهات الترفيهية العائلية في المدينة. الأجواء باردة وممتعة، والأنشطة المتوفرة كثيرة ومتنوعة وتناسب جميع الأعمار.

العروض والألعاب الثلجية مثل الانزلاق، تسلق الجليد، والأنفاق الثلجية تضيف عنصر الإثارة، بينما أماكن الجلوس الثلجية ومجسّمات الحيوانات تمنح لحظات جميلة للتصوير والاستمتاع بالأجواء. المكان واسع ومنظم، مما يجعل الحركة فيه سهلة ومريحة حتى مع الازدحام.

الطاقم محترف ومتعاون، ويقدّمون الإرشادات بوضوح ويهتمون بسلامة الزوار، خصوصًا الأطفال. كما أن الملابس الشتوية المتوفرة عند الدخول تزيد من راحة التجربة، وتسمح بالاستمتاع داخل المكان لفترة طويلة دون الشعور بالبرد الشديد.

النظافة ممتازة، والتنظيم رائع، والأسعار تعتبر مناسبة مقارنة بحجم التجربة وجودتها. كذلك توجد مناطق للراحة وشراء المشروبات الساخنة، مما يجعل الزيارة مكتملة وممتعة.

سنو أبوظبي تجربة رائعة تجمع بين المتعة والمرح والأجواء الباردة الجميلة. مكان مثالي للعائلات وللأطفال ومحبي الأنشطة الجديدة و التغير
ويستحق الزيارة أكثر من مرة
ويستحق التقيم
ويستحق التجربه

Considering the cost of AED 220, which includes just one small snowfall photo frame, I find this pricing to be very high and not reflective of the actual value received. I am very dissatisfied with this outcome.

I kindly request that this feedback be conveyed to the management/owner, as a fair adjustment in pricing would make the service more accessible and reasonable for middle-class families.

You can get the package with food and drinks included .PS : don't miss the delicious hot chocolate 😋

name: UFC GYM - MBZ | Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I've been a member of UFC for three years, but over the past year, it has become increasingly difficult to attend consistently. I have already submitted a formal complaint regarding the gym equipment, yet the issues persist.
The treadmill gives electric shocks, and the stair machine randomly speeds up and slows down, making it unsafe. The yoga mats are worn out, dirty, and have an unpleasant odor. There are only two cable ropes available for around 30 people during peak hours, and just one foam bar for the entire gym. The treadmills are positioned directly in front of the mirrors, which is inconvenient. Additionally, essential equipment such as leg grips, stretch belts, and properly stored skipping ropes are missing—the skipping rope is simply thrown into an empty cardboard box.

Most concerningly, there are no water dispensers, which is surprising since this is the first gym I’ve ever been to that lacks such a basic necessity. I am extremely disappointed with the current state of the gym and the decline in its quality. To be fair enough the coaches Ayman and Hamdi are very helpful and the Receptionist is very welcoming.

My visit to Warner Bros. World was nothing short of magical, and it is an experience I will cherish for a very long time. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the attention to detail, the immersive atmosphere, and how every corner truly brings the world of Warner Bros. characters to life. Each area felt like stepping straight into a movie or cartoon I grew up loving, and the overall organisation and cleanliness of the park were excellent.
My favourite ride was green latern.
What truly made my visit exceptional, however, was the outstanding support and kindness of a staff member named Jennifer from Cameroon. Jennifer went above and beyond her role to ensure I had the best possible experience. She took her time to patiently explain each ride to me, making sure I fully understood what to expect before going on them. Her explanations were clear, engaging, and thoughtful, which helped me feel comfortable and excited rather than overwhelmed.
What stood out most was her deep knowledge and passion for the park. Jennifer didn’t just explain the rides; she also shared the history behind the characters and the stories that inspired each attraction. Listening to her brought the entire experience to life in a meaningful way, allowing me to appreciate the creativity and legacy of Warner Bros. on a deeper level. She answered all my questions with genuine enthusiasm and never made me feel rushed.
Jennifer’s friendly attitude and willingness to help made me feel truly welcomed and valued as a guest. It is rare to meet someone who combines excellent customer service with such sincerity and dedication, and she is truly a credit to Warner Bros. World.
Because of Jennifer, my visit was not just fun, but memorable and enriching. I left the park with a smile, wonderful memories, and a deeper appreciation.I highly recommend Warner Bros. World to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience, and I sincerely hope other visitors get the chance to be guided by someone as amazing as Jennifer. She truly made my day special.

name: Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island, Abu Dhabi
review_text:
I am a theme-park enthusiast and I’ve traveled visiting many parks and resorts all over the world.

What I found at Warner Bros World just blew me away! Although I had done my homework and studied the park in advance (reading thru the website and watching vlogging YouTube videos) I was still shocked by the high-level quality of experience this park offered!

My son and I visited on New Year’s Eve and although we were told the park would be really busy because of the holidays — it was still a very manageable experience… nothing compared to a busy day at Disneyland 🤣

The first two hours of the day were the least busiest… a good time to visit the more popular attractions (Batman: Knight Flight and Tom & Jerry’s Spin)

But throughout the day we were able to enjoy ourselves at a good and simple pace… some rides… popcorn… character interactions (…and I mean intentional interactions, not just photos!)… strolling through the park taking photos (beautiful and detailed scenery throughout the whole place)… ribeye steak lunch in Bedrock… show in the main hall area… such an amazing time.

I have to say… Warner Bros World in Abu Dhabi is one of the best! And I’ll tell you why:

1. Excellent and Friendly Employees!!! I know this should be a given when dealing with the service industry… but more and more many theme parks are beginning to lower their standards in this area. However, I found every single employee at WB World to be so absolutely friendly, helpful and excellent in their area of service. While shopping in the Bedrock Boutique, two employees: Pride and Bushra, gave me FIRST CLASS shopping experience… walking me through the store and helping me to find everything Flintstone that I wanted (I’m a huge Fred Flintstone fan!)… big friendly smiles and wonderful conversations about the local area and culture. These friendly employees really make a difference in making you feel welcomed and in having such an enjoyable day in the park!

2. Character Interactions. Not only can you meet and get a photo with the characters, but they actually take time to interact with you. For example, Robin and Batwomen took no less than 5 minutes talking to us, asking us questions, making funny jokes and just making our experience so much more fun! They were amazing! Later on, we met the Flintstones and although they can’t talk, they made motions and communicated in creative ways… again, interacting and making the whole experience so much more than just taking a photo. It’s a higher level of theming altogether. Just amazing.

3. Awesome rides and attractions! I’ve visited Warner Bros Movie World in Australia (and I love it there!) but the rides and attractions at this Warner Bros World are so much more different and highly themed. I kept telling my son “these rides are so world-class” — they could easily compete alongside anything at Disney. Creative and fun… just loved them all! My favorite was the Bedrock River Adventure, but that’s because I’m a huge Flintstones fan! Love what they did with them here… and I hope they’ll never get rid of this area. I grew up in the years when Hanna-Barbera cartoons were the main programs we watched on Saturday morning television… it’s so nostalgic to see these cartoons coming back to life here at this park. Cartoon Junction was also another favorite area with Tom & Jerry, Scooby Doo and the Looney Tunes! My son (in his twenties) really loved the Metropolis and Gotham areas and attractions in this park.

Also notable mentions for the delicious food selections and many places to sit and relax in the park. Worldclass attraction that should be visited by anyone looking to have a fun day at a theme park. Loved it so much!

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text: WOOOOOOW, SPENT 3 DAYS IN F1, AMAZING

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
We were super excited to see the F1 final race of the season, especially when there were 3 drivers in the running; it made it all the more interesting! We had tickets for the South Grandstand, but our coach could only drop us off by the West Grandstand. You can only enter the tracks where your tickets are. So we walked what seems like miles in the midday heat to find our entrance.
Once we arrived, they scanned our tickets and our bags. No food and drink were allowed in. We had empty bottles in the bag and they threw that away! We were saving them to use at the water stations!

There were plenty of food choices available but they were the same in each grandstand area. We just got some food near our seats!

We had plenty of time before Quali to explore, but with the sheer amount of people, it took forever to get even from South to West Grandstand!

The Quali and the final race were amazing in such a beautiful track. The atmosphere was amazing with the fly past at the beginning and the brilliant fireworks display at the end!

The seats were cheap and uncomfortable to sit on for long hours! Plus the steps down to your seats were steep, so not good if you are afraid of heights!

Leaving the race on both days were carnage! We wanted to get a shuttle to Yas Mall afterwards, but it was impossible to get near a bus with soooooo many people pushing to get in. In the end we walked an hour to the Mall! On actual race day, there was no point considering a shuttle bus and getting a taxi was impossible! So we ended up walking 2 miles (2 hours) towards West Yas to get a taxi!

The race weekend was a phenomenal experience, but the logistics of getting out of the circuit was off putting.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the customer service at Yas Marina.
I was unable to travel to Dubai due to unexpected immigration restrictions related to my passport, and I contacted Yas Marina well in advance to request a reschedule, refund, or even a simple gift voucher so I wouldn’t completely lose my money.
They refused every option and showed no flexibility or empathy, despite the situation being completely outside my control. Most reputable attractions offer at least a credit or alternative date when a guest cannot travel due to official entry restrictions, but Yas Marina chose not to help at all.
This experience has left me feeling frustrated and unheard.
I would strongly caution others to consider the lack of customer support before booking here, especially if you are travelling internationally and may face unexpected travel issues.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
My first F1 experience at Yas was nothing short of incredible. I was there on Friday and Saturday, and watched almost all the events that took place.

Masters Historic Racing, Formula 4, Formula 2, Pirelli Hot Laps, then F1 events. There’s a lot to watch and it rewards you for getting there early.

I saw some reviews saying that they missed the race due to congestion, but I feel like that’s really their on responsibility to be timely and expect that kind of delay the closer you are to the main event. Just come early! There’s plenty to do.

I parked at Yas Mall and used the shuttles which were great, but, on the main race day the post-race walk to Yas Mall is not bad as long as you follow the clear signage and cut through Ferrari World (not the directions on your Maps Application). It was about 30-40 minutes, which is what you will end up waiting in line for an extremely packed shuttle anyway. This is honestly expected at an event of this scale, and all I felt was it was quite well organized for a scale of this size.

There was good food, staff were attentive and the atmosphere was breathtaking. I hope to have the opportunity to visit again one day.

name: Yas Marina Circuit
review_text:
Отвратительная организация гран-при Абу-Даби 2025

Мы опоздали на финальную гонку на 20 минут по вине организаторов. Из отеля мы вышли за 3 часа до гонки.

Первые 1,5ч мы пытались пройти пешком по маршруту из специального приложения, но 3 ближайших к отелю гейта были закрыты и толпы людей сливались в один вход. Это было невозможно пройти и простоять по жаре, и мы пошли на автобус.

У нас был билет Sunset lounge, который предусматривает отдельный трансфер до трека на специальном автобусе от молла. От отеля на трансфер не сесть.

За 1,5ч до гонки автобусы перестали ездить и сформировалась огромная очередь (фото людей за нами прикреплено). С нами стояли в одних условиях даже люди из паддока. За 1,5ч приехало 2 автобуса. За !!!!!1,5ч!!!!!! 2 автобуса. Это ненормально. Нас забрал второй автобус и мы ехали по пробке, никакой отдельной выеденной полосы нет. Старт гонки мы смотрели из автобуса на телефоне, имея на руках билет. Очень дорогой билет. Это ужасно.

По другую сторону молла были автобусы для других типов билетов. Сотни людей стояли на самом пекле и аналогично ждали их.

Обычный билет на трибуну = отсутствие организации, закрытые гейты, ожидание автобусов на пекле.
Билет в ~10 раз дороже в лаунж = то же самое, только автобус ждут поменьше людей и в тени.

Билет повышенного класса предусматривает комфорт логистики, никакого комфорта не было.

Билеты по типу Sunset lounge на гп Абу-Даби однозначно не советую. Это покупка испорченных впечатлений. Оно того абсолютно не стоит.

Еще проблемы:
1)Логистика и без опоздания автобуса ужасна:

В стоимость билета не включена парковка на территории, хотя на карте эта она обозначена!!!!  На физической карте, которая стоит у въезда на территорию трека. Фото с доказательством прикреплено.

Билет повышенного класса ДОЛЖЕН включать парковку, либо должна быть возможность докупить место.

На территории есть огромное количество парковочных мест, но они простаивают пустыми.

Шаттлы не работают нормально в день гонки, люди опаздывают.

2)Волонтеры ничего не знают и только путают.

В первый день мы аналогично добирались 3 часа, потому что одни нам говорили одно, в билете написано второе, водитель автобуса говорит третье.

3)Пешие маршруты не продуманы. Люди идут вдоль забора по траве, песку и камням, потому что так быстрее.

4)Места внутри Лаунжа не продуманы. Необходимо приходить заранее и занимать место, чтобы видеть трассу и экран. Людям сзади при этом обзора не будет, либо он будет сильно хуже.

Это нормально для недорогих билетов, в билетах в несколько раз дороже это должно быть предусмотрено и продумано.

Отзыв на 2025 год GP F1, это мой не первый раз и в этом году все ужасно, персонал не справляется а количеством людей, гейты открывают не во время, люди толпятся, дерутся, падают на землю, кому-то становился плохо и их откачивают мед.работники, уже не так все организовано как раньше, больше мы сюда не поедем!

Review for the 2025 F1 Grand Prix: This isn't my first time attending, and this year everything was terrible. The staff couldn't cope with the number of people, the gates didn't open on time, people were crowding, fighting, falling to the ground, some people were feeling unwell and were being treated by medical personnel. Everything is not as well organized as it used to be. We won't be coming here again.
